input.brief: CodeKiln desktop coding agent: one main window. A 56px icon rail, a project/conversation sidebar, a conversation workspace with a tab strip, message timeline and composer, and a right side panel holding an embedded browser and a mobile device preview. Restyle the whole shell so rail, sidebar, workspace and side panel read as one controlled system instead of three different greys.
screens: Main window: rail + sidebar + conversation workspace + right side panel (browser and device preview)
Same shell with the sidebar collapsed and the side panel showing the device preview

stated.emphasis: one coherent shell: rail, sidebar, workspace and side panel must read as one system

questions.question: Which of these looks closest to what you want?

options.label: 图纸台 (light)
options.description: Light · ground #e8e8e3, accent #a8890a · Archivo / Libre Franklin · Full-bleed sheet: 56px icon rail, 264px index column, then the sheet.. On these screens, the instrument strip — context 6%, ↑828K, 97% cache, branch count, elapsed time — becomes the spine: figures sit in a fixed mono column with hairline rules, and the workspace is a measured sheet rather than a card.

options.label: 夜航台 (dark)
options.description: Dark · ground #0f1f10, accent #c6f19d · Work Sans · One continuous field, no card and no borders: rail at 4% lighter, sidebar 3%, workspace the base tone, side panel 2% — all the same green-black hue.. On these screens, the run state — running, waiting for approval, queued — becomes the only colour in the window.

options.label: 编目 (light)
options.description: Light · ground #ffffff, accent #f7941d · Bricolage Grotesque / Libre Franklin · White page, 56px rail, 288px index column tinted one step (#f4f4f2) with right-aligned figures and 2px branch ticks, workspace as a wide page with a 720px measure, side panel as a right drawer with its own header band.. On these screens, the conversation tree — branches, children, 11小时前, 全部 1 — becomes a catalogue: an index column with right-aligned counts and hanging branch marks, and the workspace is the opened page.

proposals.name: 图纸台
proposals.idea: On these screens, the instrument strip — context 6%, ↑828K, 97% cache, branch count, elapsed time — becomes the spine: figures sit in a fixed mono column with hairline rules, and the workspace is a measured sheet rather than a card. CodeKiln's numbers are the one thing a chat wrapper does not have.
proposals.departs: Kills the floating rounded card and the grey-on-grey shell: one paper ground, panels separated by 1px rules only, no shadows, no card radius. Type turns condensed and figures turn mono.
proposals.layout: Full-bleed sheet: 56px icon rail, 264px index column, then the sheet. The conversation column keeps a fixed hairline gutter on its right where run state, tokens and timings stack in tabular figures; the side panel is a third ruled column, not a floating card. Screen titles are condensed; body stays sentence case. Every rule is 1px ink at 12% and every number is mono.

devices.reason: every figure in the strip (tokens, context %, cache, branch, timing) is an instrument reading, and mono keeps the columns aligned
the strip and panel headers are labels on a sheet, not prose; 11px tracked caps at 70% ink

proposals.name: 夜航台
proposals.idea: On these screens, the run state — running, waiting for approval, queued — becomes the only colour in the window. A forest-black field where everything is greyscale except the live thread: the running row, the send control and the active tab share one lime line. CodeKiln's whole job is 'is the agent still working, and what does it need from me'.
proposals.departs: Goes dark with an earth-green field instead of neutral black, drops borders entirely (tone steps of one hue), and puts the accent only on live state instead of on every control.
proposals.layout: One continuous field, no card and no borders: rail at 4% lighter, sidebar 3%, workspace the base tone, side panel 2% — all the same green-black hue. The conversation is one long measure with the composer docked at the bottom. The side panel docks flush at the right edge and inherits the tone step. Navigation is the rail plus a hairline that appears only while scrolling.

devices.reason: tokens, context and timings read as telemetry in the dark; mono keeps them from glowing
with borders gone, the composer and the device preview need one soft shadow to sit above the field

proposals.name: 编目
proposals.idea: On these screens, the conversation tree — branches, children, 11小时前, 全部 1 — becomes a catalogue: an index column with right-aligned counts and hanging branch marks, and the workspace is the opened page. Project switching reads like pulling a drawer, which is what the sidebar actually is.
proposals.departs: Replaces the equal three-column split with an index column that owns all the numbers (counts, times, branch depth) and a page that owns all the prose; navy ink instead of black, one orange rule as the only decoration.
proposals.layout: White page, 56px rail, 288px index column tinted one step (#f4f4f2) with right-aligned figures and 2px branch ticks, workspace as a wide page with a 720px measure, side panel as a right drawer with its own header band. The composer is a full-width band ruled at top, not a floating rounded box.

devices.reason: timestamps, token counts and percentages align in the index column and the status bar
Bricolage for the window title, screen headings and project names; Libre Franklin for everything read as prose; mono for figures — three jobs, no more

obvious: The version I would make by habit: system sans (Inter), #f8f8f8 shell with #ffffff rounded 12px surfaces floating on it, indigo-tinted greys, lucide icons at 18px, one warm accent (fox orange) for send and selection, three equal columns separated by 1px borders and a shadow on anything that floats. That is exactly the current window — and it reads as three different greys glued together.
